title: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.36934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traffic signal control (TSC) is essential for improving urban mobility and reducing congestion. Although roadside cameras are widely deployed at signalized intersections and provide rich visual observations of evolving traffic, existing TSC methods typically rely on manually engineered traffic states or separate perception modules, creating a gap between physical observations and control decisions. We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos. VLALight directly maps visual observations to coordinated signal actions through multi-target spatiotemporal traffic reasoning and topology-aware cooperative perception across intersections. translated_title: VLALight：一种用于交通信号控制的视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 交通信号控制（TSC）对于改善城市交通流动性和减少拥堵至关重要。尽管路边摄像头已广泛部署于信号交叉口，并能提供关于交通动态演变的丰富视觉观测，但现有的交通信号控制方法通常依赖于人工设计的交通状态或独立的感知模块，导致物理观测与控制决策之间存在鸿沟。我们提出了VLALight，这是首个能够从多视角路边视频进行端到端交通信号控制的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。VLALight通过多目标时空交通推理以及跨路口的拓扑感知协同感知，直接将视觉观测映射为协调的信号控制动作。为了建立这种能力，我们开发了一种用于视觉交通理解和信号决策的两阶段监督冷启动训练策略，随后进行协同智能体强化学习，共同……
tldr: VLALight是首个将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型应用于交通信号控制的方法，能够直接从多视角路边视频进行端到端的协同信号决策。
en_tdlr: VLALight is the first vision-language-action model for end-to-end traffic signal control, directly mapping multi-view roadside video observations to coordinated signal decisions.
